title: ClipDetails
description:
The source metadata probed from a video's decode graph.

Every field is what the decoder reported. A field the file did not carry is absent
rather than guessed, so the details screen can say `not signalled` honestly.

bit_depth.description: Bit depth of that format, when it has one.

chroma_location.description: Chroma sample location, when the source signalled it.

color_matrix.description: Matrix coefficients, when the source signalled them.

color_primaries.description: Colour primaries, when the source signalled them.

color_range.description: Colour range, when the source signalled it.

color_transfer.description: Transfer characteristic, when the source signalled it.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds derived from the frame count and rate.

frame_rate.description: Frames per second, as the decode graph reports them.

pixel_format.description: The pixel format name the decoder reported.
